x-e-m1-01.title: Ben zai zo biki? Binciken ma’anar da ke ɓoye a amsoshinsa.
x-e-m1-01.goal: Raba amsoshin Ben a tattaunawar layi bayan layi, bambance abin da aka tabbatar da wanda har yanzu ya rage, sannan ka yanke hukunci ba tare da tabbatar da “zai zo” ko “ba zai zo ba” ba.
x-e-m1-01.material:
Tattaunawa tsakanin Jisu da Ben (rubutu kawai, babu hotuna):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
x-e-m1-01.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ta hanyar haɗa alamu daga layuka da dama.
x-e-m1-01.thinking.2: Raba batutuwan da aka warware da waɗanda suka rage.
x-e-m1-01.prereq.0: Ma’anonin furuci masu sauƙi kamar might, probably, da check with.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.prompt: Karanta tattaunawar har ƙarshe, sannan ka zaɓi hukuncin da ya fi dacewa ko Ben zai zo bikin.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Raba kalmomin Ben zuwa sassa huɗu: “wasan ƙwallon ƙafa,” “lokacin biki,” “gajiya,” da “mom”.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya lokacin wasan ƙwallon ƙafa da lokacin biki gefe da gefe, ka kwatanta ko suna cin karo.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.a: “Might” yana bayyana yiwuwa ne kawai. Ka koma baya ka bincika abin da Ben ya faɗa bayansa.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bambance abin da ya faru da matsalar lokaci da abin da har yanzu ya rage.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.c: Wasan ƙwallon ƙafa da safe ne, bikin kuma da 4 p.m. Ka kwatanta lokutan biyu gefe da gefe.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.d: “Gajiya” damuwa ce da Ben ya ƙara da kansa. Ka yi tunani ko za a iya karanta wannan kaɗai a matsayin ƙin yarda.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.explain: Wasan ƙwallon ƙafa da safe ne, bikin kuma da 4 p.m., saboda haka lokutan ba sa cin karo. Ben ya ce kawai wataƙila zai gaji, kuma a ƙarshe ya ce zai fara tambayar mom. Don haka akwai abin da aka warware (lokaci) da abin da ya rage (izinin mahaifiyarsa), kuma har yanzu ba a yanke shawara ba.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimlolin Korean biyu ko uku da ke bayyana dalilan hukuncin da ke sama. Ɗauko aƙalla furuci ɗaya na Turanci daga Ben, sannan ka faɗi abin da aka warware da abin da ya rage.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta abu guda da aka warware tare da lokacinsa.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sannan ka nemo abin da ya rage a kalmomin Ben na ƙarshe, ka rubuta shi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ambaci shaidar lokaci da abin da ya rage duka?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ɗauko furucin Turanci na Ben a matsayin shaida?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka guji tabbatar da “zai zo/ba zai zo ba”?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.0: Wasan ƙwallon ƙafa da safe ne, bikin kuma da 4 p.m., don haka lokutan ba sa cin karo. Amma Ben ya ce “Let me check with my mom first.”, saboda haka izinin mom ɗinsa ya rage, kuma na yanke hukuncin cewa har yanzu ba mu sani ba.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.1: “That might work” yana nufin yana yiwuwa, kuma wasan safe da biki na 4 p.m. ba sa cin karo. Gajiya damuwa ce kawai, kuma da yake ya ce a ƙarshe zai tambayi mom, hukuncin ya danganta da amsarta.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kyakkyawar amsa ce da ta tantance gajiya dabam.

x-e-m1-02.title: Shin “That’s fine.” da gaske yana nufin ba damuwa?
x-e-m1-02.goal: Karanta ɗan ƙaramin ɓangare na tattaunawa a lokaci guda, yanke hukunci game da yadda mai magana yake ji a ɓoye, sannan ka sake duba hukuncinka na baya idan sabon alama ya bayyana.
x-e-m1-02.material: Sam da Dad suna magana game da shirin Friday. Ana bayyana tattaunawar a sassa uku. Rubutu kawai aka bayar, babu hotuna.
x-e-m1-02.thinking.0: Sake duba hukunci domin ya dace da sababbin alamu.
x-e-m1-02.thinking.1: Yi amfani da furucin sautin magana (“…” da “Fine?” maimakon waƙafi) a matsayin alamu.
x-e-m1-02.thinking.2: Bambance ma’anar zahiri da ma’anar ɓoye.
x-e-m1-02.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar fine, tickets, da birthday party.
x-e-m1-02.prereq.1: Sautin tattaunawa (…, ?) zai iya zama alamar ji.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.prompt: Karanta tattaunawar a hankali ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan kowane lokaci ka zaɓi hukuncinka game da yadda Sam yake ji.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo sabon sauti ko kalma guda a wannan sashe.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko hukuncinka na baya ya dace da sabon sashe.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Daga wannan tattaunawa kaɗai, wane hukunci ne ya fi ma’ana game da yadda Sam yake ji?
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba za ka iya yanke hukunci daga layi guda ba. “Fine” na iya nufin komai ya yi, ko kuma an faɗe shi ba tare da jin daɗi ba.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kamar yana farin ciki, amma ba tabbatacce ba ne.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: “Fine” na iya nufin “da kyau”, saboda haka wannan fassara ce mai yiwuwa. Ka kuma kula da sauti kamar “Oh.” da “...”.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Har yanzu babu kalmomi ko furuci da ke nuna yana fushi. Yanke hukunci kan babban ji daga gajeriyar amsa ba shi da isasshen shaida.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ya ce na gode, amma wataƙila akwai wani abu da yake damunsa.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka ɗauki “Oh.” da “...” a matsayin alamu. Layi guda ne kawai, saboda haka ba za ka tabbata ba.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Karanta sabon alama, sannan ka sake yanke hukunci game da abin da Sam yake so da gaske.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Fassarar cewa Sam yana da shirin biki kuma tikitin ya yi tsada, don haka yana da wuya ya faɗi komai, ta fi dacewa da sabon alamar. Idan ka fara yanke hukuncin “yana fushi”, ya kamata ka gyara shi a nan.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ba ya son shagulgulan kade-kade, saboda haka ya amsa da kaushi da gangan.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sam bai ce ba ya son shagalin ba. Ka yi tunani game da dalilin da ya sa aka ambaci bikin.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yana zargin Dad saboda tikitin ya yi tsada.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: “Kamar tsada” ana iya karanta shi a matsayin damuwa game da yadda Dad zai ji ma. Nemo alamar da ke nuna ko sautin yana zargi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yana son zuwa bikin amma ya kasa faɗa saboda yana iya ɓata wa Dad rai.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya haɗa alamun biyu: shirin bikin da tikiti mai tsada.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Bayan karanta har ƙarshe, yaya za ka sake fassara “That’s... fine.” na farko?
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Bikin yana ƙarewa da 6, shagalin kade-kade kuma yana farawa da 7:30, saboda haka zai iya zuwa duka biyun. Za ka iya sake fassara ta: “fine” na farko yana da ma’anar zahiri dabam da ma’anar ɓoyensa.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: “Fine” alama ce ta matsala, kuma yanzu an warware matsalar.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka haɗa sautin farko da martanin ƙarshe.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Babu matsala tun farko, kuma “fine” ma da gaske aka faɗa.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan babu matsala, Dad ba zai ce “You don’t sound happy.” ba, Sam kuma ba zai ambaci bikin ba.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Matsalar ta ɓace ne domin Dad ya soke shagalin kade-kade.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ba a soke shagalin ba. Sake karanta lokutan biyun, 7:30 da 6:00.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.reflect: Yayin karanta sassa ukun, akwai lokacin da hukuncinka game da jin Sam ya canza? Idan ya canza, yi tunanin abin da aka faɗa da ya jawo shi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi layin da alamar sauti ta farko ta bayyana cewa “That’s... fine.” na Sam wataƙila ba farin ciki na gaske ba ne.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.hint.0: A layin farko da Sam ya faɗa, nemo alamomi ko gajerun sautukan da aka yi amfani da su ban da kalmomi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Wane layi ne ya zo kafin Dad ya ce “You don’t sound happy.”?
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.explain: A layi na 2, Sam ya faɗi “fine” tare da “Oh.” da “...”. Sautin yana nuna shakka. Layi na 3 ne Dad ya lura da sautin, layi na 4 kuma ne aka bayyana dalilin kai tsaye.

x-e-m1-03.title: Sanarwar hoton aji ga abokin da ba ya nan: gyara abin da aka kwafa ba daidai ba.
x-e-m1-03.goal: A taƙaitaccen bayani da aka kwafa daga sanarwa, nemo layin da ya bambanta da sanarwar, sannan ka gyara shi da jimlar Turanci guda.
x-e-m1-03.material:
Sanarwar makaranta (rubutu kawai, babu hotuna):

Notice to Grade 7 Students
Class Photo Day
Date: Thursday, May 9
Time: 8:40 a.m. - 9:10 a.m.
Place: School gym
Please wear your school uniform for the photo. If it rains, the photo will be taken in your classroom. Also bring your PE clothes for the afternoon class.

Akwai saƙon da abokin aji ya taƙaita ya aika wa abokin da ba ya nan.
x-e-m1-03.thinking.0: Kwatanta asalin sanarwa da taƙaitaccen rubutu layi bayan layi.
x-e-m1-03.thinking.1: Bambance abubuwa biyu da suke kama da juna.
x-e-m1-03.thinking.2: Tabbatar da gyararren jimla ta dace da asalin.
x-e-m1-03.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar uniform, PE clothes, da afternoon.
x-e-m1-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a taƙaitaccen saƙon da bai dace da sanarwar ba.
x-e-m1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo layin sanarwar da kowace jimlar taƙaitaccen bayani ta fito daga gare shi, sannan ka haɗa su da layuka.
x-e-m1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga sau nawa sanarwar ta ambaci tufafi.
x-e-m1-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 bai dace ba. Sanarwar ta ce a sa rigar makaranta domin hoto, sannan a kawo kayan PE domin ajin rana. Layuka na 1, 2 da 4 sun dace da sanarwar.
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba da jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu. Ka sa ya dace da sanarwar, kuma ka tabbatar ba a gauraya tufafin hoton da abin da za a kawo domin ajin rana ba.
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta a jimla guda abin da za a sa lokacin ɗaukar hoto.
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo a sanarwar lokacin da ake bukatar kayan PE, ka ƙara bayanin, ko ka bincika ko ba a bukatar kayan PE.
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya faɗin layin sanarwar da gyararren jimlarka ta dace da shi?
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yanke shawarar ko ya dace a bar kayan PE gaba ɗaya ko a haɗa su da ajin rana?
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Jimlarka ta Turanci cikakkiyar jimla ce?
x-e-m1-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa gajera ce da ta haɗa kayan PE da lokacin rana.

x-e-m1-04.title: Imel na neman shiga sansani: zaɓen abin tambaya da ba a rubuta a fostar ba.
x-e-m1-04.goal: Bambance bayanin da tuni yake a fostar da wanda ya ɓace, sannan ka yi tambaya cikin ladabi a imel ɗin Turanci game da abin da ake bukata da gaske a yanayinka amma ba ya nan.
x-e-m1-04.material:
Fostar sansanin Turanci na Saturday (rubutu kawai, babu hotuna):

Saturday English Camp
For grade 7-9 students
10:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m.
Place: City Library, Room 2
Fee: 5,000 won
To join, send an email to Ms. Park.

Haeun (grade 7) tana son shiga. Amma ajin iyo na safiyar Saturday yana ƙarewa da 10, kuma tafiya da ƙafa daga wurin ninkaya zuwa laburare tana ɗaukar mintuna 20. Sansanin yana ci gaba har 3, don haka lokacin abincin rana yana tsakiyarsa, kuma fostar ba ta faɗi komai game da abincin rana ba.
x-e-m1-04.thinking.0: Bambance bayanin da aka riga aka bayar da wanda ya ɓace.
x-e-m1-04.thinking.1: Zaɓen tambayoyin da ake bukata a yanayina.
x-e-m1-04.thinking.2: Rubuta imel ɗin buƙata cikin ladabi.
x-e-m1-04.prereq.0: Tambayoyi masu ladabi kamar Could I ...? da Can I ...?
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk abubuwan da Haeun ya kamata ta tambayi Ms. Park ta imel. Kada ka zaɓi tambayoyin da fostar ta riga ta amsa.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Soke bayanin da tuni yake a fostar, abu ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cikin tambayoyin da suka rage, nemo waɗanda suke da alaƙa da lokacin ajin iyo na Haeun ko abincin rana.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.r.a: Aji yana layi na biyu na fostar. Ka bincika ko za a iya samun amsar tambayarka daga fostar?
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.r.b: An zaɓi wannan tambaya ta hanyar kwatanta lokacin da ajin iyo na Haeun yake ƙarewa da lokacin tafiya zuwa laburare, da lokacin farawa a fostar.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.r.c: An rubuta kuɗin shiga a fostar. Tambaya ce da tuni take da amsa.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.r.d: An zaɓi wannan tambayar ne saboda an haɗa cewa sansanin yana ci gaba har zuwa 3 da cewa fostar ba ta ambaci abincin rana ba.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.r.e: An rubuta wurin a fostar. Tambaya ce da tuni take da amsa.
x-e-m1-04.s.s1.explain: Fostar tana da bayanin aji (7-9), lokaci, wuri da kuɗin shiga. Abin da Haeun take bukata amma fostar ba ta faɗa ba shi ne ko yana da kyau ta zo a makare (ta iso kusan 10:20 bayan iyo) da ko ya kamata ta kawo abincin rana.
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta imel ga Ms. Park da Turanci, jimloli 2 zuwa 4. Haɗa gaisuwa cikin ladabi, jimlar cewa kana son shiga, da tambayoyin biyu da ka zaɓa a sama.
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta gaisuwa da jimlar da ke cewa kana son shiga.
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta kowace tambaya a matsayin jimla guda ta amfani da tsari kamar Could I ...? ko Do I ...?
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Tambayoyin biyun sun fito ne daga yanayin Haeun?
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka guji sake tambayar abin da tuni yake a fostar?
x-e-m1-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce gajera da ta yi tambayoyin biyun kawai ba tare da bayar da dalilin iyo ba.

x-e-m1-05.title: Takardar maƙwabci: menene ainihin abin da yake son faɗa?
x-e-m1-05.goal: Nemo ainihin manufar takarda da aka ɓoye cikin yabo da gaisuwa, sannan ka bayyana da shaida dalilin da ya sa aka faɗa a kaikaice.
x-e-m1-05.material:
Takardar da maƙwabcin bene na ƙasa ya manna a ƙofar gaban bene na sama (rubutu kawai, babu hotuna):

Hello! I'm Tom Lee from apartment 302, below you. I love music too, and your piano sounds great! By the way, my baby goes to bed at 9 p.m., and she sleeps very lightly. Thank you!
x-e-m1-05.thinking.0: Tsara aikin kowace jimla (“gaisuwa,” “yabo,” ko “wani batu”).
x-e-m1-05.thinking.1: Nemo babban abin da ke zuwa bayan by the way.
x-e-m1-05.thinking.2: Tantance dalilin faɗin wani abu a kaikaice.
x-e-m1-05.prereq.0: By the way ana amfani da shi wajen kawo sabon batu.
x-e-m1-05.prereq.1: Ma’anar sleep lightly (mai saurin farkawa daga barci).
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.prompt: Wace ce babbar manufar da Tom Lee ya rubuta wannan takardar dominta?
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faɗi aikin kowace jimla: “gaisuwa,” “yabo,” ko “wani batu dabam”.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da yadda abin da ya zo bayan By the way yake alaƙa da yabon da ya gabata.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.a: Yabon maƙwabci game da iya buga piano da kyau.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.a: Yabon yana cikin takardar, amma ka kwatanta da abin da ya zo bayan By the way domin gano ko takardar yabo kawai ce.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.b: Ƙoƙarin neman shawarwarin kiɗan da jaririn zai iya so.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.b: An ambaci jariri, amma bincika ko takardar tana neman shawarar kiɗa.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.c: Neman su rage sauti bayan ƙarfe 9 cikin ladabi.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bambance aikin sassa ukun takardar (gaisuwa, yabo, magana game da jariri).
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.o.d: Faɗa wa mutumin bene na sama inda suke zama da yi musu sallama.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.r.d: Gabatar da kansa yana cikin jimla ta farko, amma ka yi la’akari ko wannan ita ce babbar manufar takardar.
x-e-m1-05.s.s1.explain: Takardar ta fara da gaisuwa da yabo sannan ta kawo cewa jaririn yana kwanciya da ƙarfe 9 kuma barcinsa yana saurin farkawa, ta hanyar amfani da “By the way”. Ba ta faɗi kai tsaye “don Allah ku yi shiru” ba, amma ana iya karanta ta a matsayin roƙon su rage sauti bayan 9 p.m.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimlolin Korean biyu ko uku game da dalilin da ya sa Tom Lee bai faɗi buƙatar kai tsaye ba, ya zaɓi wannan hanyar kaikaice. Ɗauko aƙalla furuci ɗaya na Turanci daga takardar a matsayin shaida.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo furuci guda na Turanci a takardar da yake kama da buƙata.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da yadda wannan furucin zai shafi yadda maƙwabcin zai ji.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ɗauko shaida guda ta Turanci daga takardar?
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin kaikaicewar daga ra’ayin maƙwabcin?
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana manufar a sarari, wato “buƙata”?
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.model.0: Ta hanyar bayar da dalilin “jaririna yana kwanciya da ƙarfe 9 p.m.”, ya yi buƙatar a hankali ba tare da ɓata wa maƙwabcin rai ba.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.model.1: Faɗin “a yi shiru” kai tsaye zai iya zama kamar rashin ladabi, saboda haka ya fara da yabo sannan ya ambaci jaririn da yake kwanciya da 9, ya bar maƙwabcin ya fahimta da kansa.
x-e-m1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta kuma bayyana aikin yabon.

x-e-m1-06.title: Saƙon neman a dawo maka da abin da ka aro: zaɓi saƙo mai bayyananniyar manufa, sannan ka rubuta naka.
x-e-m1-06.goal: Bambance saƙonnin da manufarsu ba ta fito fili ba da waɗanda take a sarari, sannan ka rubuta saƙo da kanka da zai bayyana manufar iri ɗaya ga aboki cikin ladabi da bayyananniyar magana.
x-e-m1-06.material: Mina ta ara wa abokinta Jun littafin kimiyya makonni 2 da suka wuce. Tana da jarabawa ranar Friday, saboda haka tana bukatar littafin. Mina tana son aika saƙo ta roƙi a dawo mata da littafin. Ga saƙonni huɗu da Mina ta rubuta a matsayin zaɓuɓɓuka.
